His story

Salam/ Greetings Everyone. It is with a heavy heart that that we share that the news of our beloved, Joha Bin Hassan, has passed on 05 November. We would like to thank each and every one of you; who have known him for his passionate, love and joy for the wonderful community that he had created through sharing his home-cooked recipes or just his daily life.

We hope you’d continue the legacy when you try his recipes for your next meal. For those who knew him personally, we hope you keep him in your hearts and prayers - forgive him for any shortcomings and to remember him as the great man that he is.

Thank you for all your prayers and well-wishes, and made him happy through this lifetime.

In loving memory

Joha Bin Hassan

1960-2026

Allahummaghfirlahu warhamhu wa ’afihi wa ’fu ’anhu.

“O Allah, forgive him, have mercy on him, grant him safety, and pardon him.”
